interpretation_corrections: E1 n_100000 and n_1000000 labels are development-budget identifiers, not counts to call fitting rows. E4/E5 manifests explicitly confirm 80,000 fitting + 10,000 tuning + 10,000 calibration rows and 500,000 test rows.

Supervisor ledger reconciliation is separate from manifest status: RBF has 25 supervisor-complete and 20 terminal_failure cells; its 45 method manifests show 25 complete, 9 failed, 11 started. The 11 started-looking manifests are not process-liveness evidence.

RBF supervisor ledger records five n_100000 terminal_failure cells; one explicitly timed out during test_inference and four have no timeout-phase classification in this evidence. Ten other RBF cells were recorded timed out in trial_0_fit_and_tune. These are timeout/lifecycle observations, not memory-failure labels.

Historical E1 resource observations support admission reservations only. Do not claim 100,000 rows were fitting rows for E1; do not claim the later 600-second policy was tested in E1, whose configured trial limit was 180 seconds.

The observed trial rows are the rows present in 224 KNN and 175 RBF-SVM records. They do not prove that every planned trial-history slot or auxiliary history is present; preserve the documented E1 auxiliary tuning-history provenance caveat unchanged.
The live resource/headroom observation is inherited from the V1 timestamp shown in its own field and was not refreshed for V2. Do not treat it as current liveness.
